template.name: V1N1 Lonny Breakout
template.entry_long: close > donchian_high_prev(high,{p0}) and roc(ema(close,{p1}),{p2}) > {p0} and rsi(close,14) < {p1}
template.notes: A decisive close above the 20-bar opening range (TradeRange fallback) with a rising EMA(20) slope and RSI(14) below the 70 stochastic boundary captures the documented long breakout, and loss of the EMA slope or an overbought reading exits. London/New York session times, MinRangePoints, breakout-distance bands, point stop/target, trailing stop, and the bar timeout are unavailable.
